project.project_title: Licensed Electrical PE (NV) Needed to Review & Stamp Electrical As‑Built Drawings

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: My proposal is a turnaround of 6 business days for the review and stamp, at a fee of \$320, because the project change is very simple. Please let me know. Thanks.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Even though 84 pages may seem daunting, you really do not need to review all of them. I initially felt the same way, but the actual work is limited to reviewing the minor modifications listed in the word file. For this change, I am a licensed mechanical engineer, and my scope comes down to only the highlighted portion of the attached file. The electrical scope is similarly limited. If \$480 works for you, let’s finalize it at that amount and I will inform the client. Please advise.

value_updates.review_scope: only the minor electrical modifications listed in the Word file

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Before this project’s changes, the as-built drawings were captured in the .pdf copy. The project’s electrical revisions appear in the word file you are reviewing and approving so the as-built electrical sheets can be amended.

value_updates.review_outcome: approve the electrical revisions so the as-built electrical sheets can be amended

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Would pictures of the changes that align with the written description be sufficient? If you still require redlines, I will request them; I just want to determine the minimum documentation needed to kick off the project.

ambiguity.description: It remained unresolved whether photographs aligned with the written description were sufficient or formal redline drawings were required.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: For kickoff, the minimum documentation I would typically require consists of the written scope of work, which has already been provided; photos of every modified area; the room numbers associated with each change; and any sketches, screenshots, or informal markups showing the approximate locations of the work.

value_updates.room_identifiers_required: Room numbers associated with each change

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: To verify that the completed work matches what is specified in the word file, I’ve asked the client to provide pictures of the changes.

value_updates.verification_reference: Changes specified in the word file
value_updates.verification_criterion: Pictures of the completed changes must allow comparison with the changes specified in the word file

source_message.text: Marisol, I hope you are doing well. source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Marisol, thank you for responding. These callouts contain the same material you stamped in the letter; the only change is that content formerly presented as written annotations now appears on schematic sheets. You can verify the match because each callout heading in your letter corresponds to the description shown in the schematic.

Please reconsider and stamp these original-scope callouts in a schematic layout. This work belongs to the second milestone for addressing the city’s and client’s comments.

Thank you in advance for your support.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: For the attached project, the required deliverables are permit-ready Mechanical, Plumbing and Electrical drawings with an electrical PE stamp; I will handle the Mechanical and Plumbing stamps. Would you be available to support this additional work, and if so, what price and timeline would you quote?

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Given that I understood the scope to cover only review and stamping, could you clarify whether I am also expected to provide additional drawings and calculations?

ambiguity.description: Whether the freelancer was responsible for creating the electrical drawings, rather than only reviewing and stamping them, required client clarification.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: To clarify the scope, you would create and stamp the electrical drawings, while I would stamp the mechanical drawings. You would also perform whatever calculations are required to produce the drawings; please confirm that this is within your competence. The applicable scope includes Manual. J, Manual S, and Manual D.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I'll ask the client again. Just to confirm, this includes permit-ready Mechanical, Plumbing and Electrical drawings with all necessary load calculations, correct? T 24 is not needed, but HvAC sizing calculations are required. Could you also provide your California electrical PE license number? The project should kick off soon, no later than five weeks from now.
